title: Coroutine Gauntlet
prompt: Implement Generator<T> + counter (as in the lesson) and the `evens` filtering adapter (consumes src by move).

tests.name: counter yields inclusively
tests.hint: The lesson's generator verbatim; the counter body is a simple inclusive for-loop with co_yield.

tests.name: evens filters through the frame
tests.hint: Generator<int> evens(Generator<int> src) { while (src.next()) if (src.value() % 2 == 0) co_yield src.value(); } — src lives in the frame; the while ends the coroutine when src exhausts.
